{
  "name": "open-paths",
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "description": "Click a file path in a Claude Code reply and the file opens in its app: Word, Preview, Excel, VS Code for code. Not a Finder reveal.",
  "userConfig": {
    "editor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Editor",
      "description": "Where code and text files open: vscode, cursor, zed, sublime, idea, default, or an app name",
      "default": "vscode"
    }
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "function-hooks",
    "paths",
    "links",
    "open",
    "files",
    "editor"
  ],
  "author": {
    "name": "Kian Khooban",
    "url": "https://github.com/kiankhooban"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths",
  "repository": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "displayName": "Open Paths",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths#readme",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths/blob/main/PRIVACY.md",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://github.com/kiankhooban/open-paths/blob/main/LICENSE"
}
